claimBoundary: Attribution records who created, hosted, owned, curated, or verified a source; attribution is not rights permission.
Creator portfolio scores and Go/Modify/Single/Hold judgments do not prove SourceRow completeness, rights approval, partnership, public-catalog approval, or current sensitive applicability.
Internal review/provider metadata is excluded from user projections.

roleDefinitions.definition: The actual author, video producer, recipe creator, instructor, or organization that created the source content.
The platform or service that hosts, distributes, entitles, or exposes the source.
roleDefinitions.requiredWhen: A provider is distinct from the creator or source owner.

roleDefinitions.definition: The entity that operates, publishes, or controls the source page or source rights.
roleDefinitions.requiredWhen: The owner is known or differs from the creator/provider.

roleDefinitions.definition: The entity that selected several child sources for a source-curation Map.
roleDefinitions.requiredWhen: mapType=source_curation or another explicit curation act exists.

roleDefinitions.definition: Official, professional, or separately reviewed evidence that bounds sensitive facts, applicability, freshness, or safety.
roleDefinitions.requiredWhen: A sensitive schedule or caution depends on evidence beyond the creator source.
roleDefinitions.mustNotAdd: New execution Items unless the trust anchor becomes the primary source of a separate Flow.

properties.canonicalUrl: optional canonical profile or organization URL

entityRecordShape.additionalIdentityRule: The same entity may fill several roles, but each role field remains explicit.

properties.creatorIds: unique array of entity IDs in the creator role; may be empty only when genuinely unknown
properties.providerIds: unique array of entity IDs in the provider role
properties.sourceOwnerIds: unique array of entity IDs in the source-owner role
properties.curatorIds: unique array of entity IDs in the curator role
properties.rightsRefId: optional reference to separate rights contract
properties.reviewRefIds: optional internal review references; never user export

properties.sourceRowIds: non-empty unique array of SourceRow IDs
properties.sourceUrl: source URL used for the trace
official or reviewed supporting source URL
properties.purpose: freshness | locale | safety | legal_boundary | administrative_boundary | professional_confirmation
properties.note: internal review note; not automatically exported

rules: A source URL being public cannot set rightsReviewStatus=approved.
Creator permission, provider terms, and source-owner permission are separate evidence.
User-facing attribution must not leak internal rights-review notes.

userVisible: source checked date when freshness matters
projectionPolicy.rule: Loss of required source attribution or sensitive boundary makes the projection forbidden.

mapRules.rule: Each child Flow retains its own primarySourceId, creatorIds, providerIds, and sourceTrace.
A curator may group child Flows but does not replace child creators or source owners.
A platform collection cannot be represented as one creator when child sources have different creators.
Rows from different primary sources or creators cannot silently form one Flow spine; use separately source-owned child Flows in a Map.
A single_content_candidate or single_sensitive_schedule cannot imply a creator-wide Flow Map.

validationRules: Every attribution entity reference resolves to exactly one entityRecord.
Every Flow has exactly one primarySourceId and one sourceUrl.
Every source-derived Item has at least one sourceTrace entry and every sourceRowId resolves.
creatorIds, providerIds, sourceOwnerIds, and curatorIds are unique arrays and remain role-distinct.
source_curation requires at least one curatorId and preserves child attribution.
trustAnchorRefs are required when a sensitive boundary depends on supporting evidence.
Attribution never mutates rightsReviewStatus, promotionState, or creator decisionBand.
Internal-only fields are forbidden in Calendar, Checklist, Todo, Sheet, and Memo user artifacts.

creatorPortfolioExamples.rule: Our Table may be creator and curator; each recipe source remains separately attributable and ordering is not execution order.
AND Studio is creator; hosting platform remains provider; each video is an independent child Flow.
만개의레시피 may be provider while individual recipe authors remain creators.
오늘의집 may provide or curate content but different authors cannot be collapsed into one creator.
Fitpet attribution does not replace current veterinary/official trust review and does not create a creator-wide Map.
